title: Time dilation
references: Einstein, A., Zur Elektrodynamik bewegter Körper, Annalen der Physik 322(10), 891-921 (1905), doi:10.1002/andp.19053221004
Rindler, W., Relativity: Special, General, and Cosmological, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2006)
validity_domain: Interval measured by an inertial observer for a clock moving at constant speed v < c, given its proper time tau.
limitations: Constant velocity in an inertial frame; acceleration and gravitational time dilation are not included
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty

variables.tau: Proper time measured by the moving clock
variables.v: Speed of the clock in the observer frame
